fusions.name: Seed Spit
fusions.desc: Spits a seed that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 5 seconds. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Rootbound Landing
fusions.desc: Drops to the ground and sends roots through it, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stunning them for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Understory
fusions.desc: Opens a grove where you stand. For 8 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

fusions.name: Slipped Stitch
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once, healing you for 5% of your maximum health per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
